sentences.en: Juha was in a far city.
He finished the work in the evening.
He wanted to return home fast.

sentences.ar: הוא שאל איש בדרך על הזמן.
sentences.en: He asked a man on the road about the time.

sentences.ar: הוא שאל: כמה זמן עד הכפר?
sentences.en: He asked: how long until the village?
The man looked at him and did not answer.
Juha asked again in a loud voice.
The man still did not say anything.
Juha grew angry and began to walk.
After a little the man called to him.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: שעתיים, אם תלך ככה.
sentences.en: He said: two hours, if you walk like that.
Juha came back and asked: why now?
The man said: I did not know before.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: לא ראיתי איך אתה הולך.
sentences.en: He said: I did not see how you walk.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: עכשיו ראיתי, ואני יודע.
sentences.en: He said: now I saw, and I know.
Juha laughed and continued on the road.
